letter.subject: Grievance regarding claim settlement under Family Health Optima
letter.body: To the Grievance Officer, Star Health and Allied Insurance. I am writing as the policyholder of Family Health Optima. For Pharmacy & consumables, the estimated amount was Rs 28,000, paid was Rs 17,500, and the variance is Rs 10,500. For Diagnostics (lab + ultrasound), the estimated amount was Rs 14,000, paid was Rs 8,750, and the variance is Rs 5250. The policy quote states that Associated Medical Expenses does not include cost of pharmacy and consumables, cost of implants and medical devices and cost of diagnostics, ICU charges and hence proportionate deduction will not be applicable on these items. The formula shows that pharmacy is excluded from proportionate deduction: payable in full and diagnostics is excluded from proportionate deduction: payable in full. There is a Potential inconsistency in the settlement. My claim was checked and settlement happened 23 days after submission, which is beyond the limit of 15 days, making it At risk. There is an indicative interest of Rs 847 calculated at the rate of 0.07 for 37 days. I request you to Review this matter and ensure the correct amount is Payable as Supported by the policy terms. [Your name], [Policy number], [Claim number]
